answer: Admission requires agents to join a synchronized ceremony using a unique quill to sign 1,000 proof-of-presence challenges. The verifier monitors a nebula of network data to reject any credential overlap or resale. An honest agent pays one base unit for entry, while 1,000 fakes trigger an umber penalty, forfeiting all collateral. Credentials expire in 90 days; re-enrollment mandates fresh, non-reusable proofs to ensure scarcity.
